column1: # What was decided about every public member of every class the binding wraps.
# Written and checked by tools/audit_api.py -- see that file for why.
#   used       the binding calls it, and it is not itself something a Gren
#              program names -- geometry, a setter a render goes through
#   internal   Turbo Vision's own plumbing: painting, buffers, stream
#              persistence, virtuals a subclass overrides and a caller never calls
#   skipped    a decision not to offer it, with the reason
#   todo       a gap somebody has agreed is a gap, with what it would buy
# A member with no line here is one nobody has looked at, and that is what the
# audit fails on. `todo` lines are reported and do not fail.
